browser.prefetchResponseObservation: Sampled admin page responses were generally 6-71ms; shared navigation roots reached about 170ms. No sampled prefetch response approached the 1.6-1.8s Explore response duration.

diagnosis: The price query scans the five-character index and builds a temporary ORDER BY B-tree. Its full projection takes 1.5-2.5s natively and the browser first row takes about 1.9s. Substring and pattern native projections finish in 57-159ms; their browser first rows were 0.37-0.90s. Link prefetch traffic was present but sampled responses were short and does not explain the price-specific delay.
